evidence: batch_0057 (4,000 games, sieger + lane6, tower 4 / Nexus 8, roster 1.7.0; RQ-048): bastion 62.2% [59.7, 64.6], marrow 59.4% [57.0, 61.8], wisp 59.2% [56.8, 61.6], ossuar 41.1% [38.8, 43.6], corvane 41.1% [38.7, 43.5]. marrow's R is the AREA engine P-0013 missed (1.87x income, cooldown 1); bastion wins on a 3-hit Q and dies 0.14 times a game; wisp stayed high after its W went to cooldown 2; corvane earns 0.25x the mean with two of its basics on cooldown 2; ossuar's only cheap damage is a 1-hit Q.
hypothesis: One lever on each moves each champion toward 50 without touching the other twenty. Changing five different champions at once still attributes by champion, since each champion's own win-rate delta is dominated by its own change.
success_metric: Against the paired first 2,000 games of batch_0057 (same seeds, same draws): each of the five inside 45-55, and no other champion pushed outside 45-55.
revert_if: Any of the five overshoots past the other side of the band (below 43 or above 57), or any untouched champion moves by more than 5 points.
side_effects: Two kits carry declared exceptions: bastion's R now exceeds the 1.75x spread cap because its Q shrank, and wisp's R nets 2.5 at cooldown 2. ossuar sits at 28 points on paper.
note: Read as batch_0058: 2,000 games, seed 5701 (paired with batch_0057 games 0-1999), four shards of 500.
